Mutant Feature - Bird Head.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Bird Head
A feathered bird head with a short curved beak on a human body.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Bird Head.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual only: a permanent Mutant body feature; keep it in every portrait, even with an Emitter or Transformation Quirk Type. Adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two features for one body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the alphabetically first. Quirkless or No Quirk: no heteromorph body; do not draw it.

Portrait: a bird's head on a human neck and body: short smooth feathers over face and skull, a short curved beak in place of nose and mouth, large forward-facing round eyes, a crest of longer feathers where hair would grow. Feathers follow the selected hair color; beak dark gray; eyes follow the selected eye color. Hair Style traits shape the crest where they can; facial hair traits are skipped. If another Mutant Feature adds ears, a beak or tusks, this head's anatomy takes precedence.
